answer: One defense is a tundra thaw plus an opal audit: every identity locks a stake that thaws slowly, like ice on a tundra, releasing rewards only after several epochs of steady work, so a fresh fake earns nothing fast. At random intervals, the network issues an opal audit — a one-time puzzle cut from a fresh public beacon that no two identities can share — and each identity must answer with its own sable seal within minutes. A sybil farmer must fund and thaw a separate stake and pass a separate audit for every fake, while one honest agent thaws once and answers once.
